# `kernel/arch/vax/uba` — architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — vax/uba

## English

This directory contains architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — vax/uba.

`config.mk` records 10 source file(s) here: `kgclock.c`, `np.c`, `ps.c`, `qd.c`, `qfont.c`, `qv.c`, `tmscp.c`, `uba.c`, `uda.c`, `vs.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
